name: Kyun Kyun Dou ~Otona no Tame no Oisha-san Gokko~
original_name: きゅんきゅん堂 ～大人のためのお医者さんごっこ～
source:
Main character is a skillful acupuncturist who knows a secret technique passed from generation to generation, but which involves sex. A foreigner woman visits this center and gets helped by this technique. She stays at the center and swears not to leave until she learns this technique herself.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名技艺高超的针灸师，掌握着家族代代相传的秘术，只是治疗过程会涉及性行为。一名外国女性来到诊所，并通过这种秘术获得帮助。此后她留在诊所，发誓在亲自学会秘术前绝不离开。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
